META_DESCRIPTION: Track rent, mortgage, HOA, maintenance, and home insurance. FincWin's Housing envelope keeps your biggest expense under your closest attention.
HERO_SUB: Rent, mortgage, HOA fees, home insurance, maintenance — housing is where most people spend 30–40% of their income. FincWin's Housing envelope makes every dollar of it visible and controlled.
PAIN_H2:
Housing costs are more than
just your rent or mortgage.
PAIN_ITEM_1_H3: Maintenance surprises that wipe your savings
PAIN_ITEM_1_P: The water heater breaks in November. The AC fails in July. Home repairs average $3,000–$5,000/year. Without a housing maintenance budget, every repair is a crisis.
PAIN_ITEM_2_H3: HOA fees that creep up every year
PAIN_ITEM_2_P: Your HOA was $250/month when you moved in. It's $340 now. Special assessments add hundreds more without warning. If it's not tracked, it quietly grows into a significant expense.
PAIN_ITEM_3_H3: The true cost of homeownership is never just the mortgage
PAIN_ITEM_3_P: Property tax, home insurance, PMI, maintenance reserve — homeowners routinely underestimate total housing costs by $400–$600/month. The envelope reveals the real number.
FEATURES_H2:
The Housing envelope:
see the complete picture of home.
CARD_1_P: Mortgage or rent, plus insurance, HOA, and property tax — all in one envelope. See your true monthly housing cost, not just the payment on the box the realtor showed you.
CARD_2_P: Set aside a monthly maintenance budget as a recurring envelope allocation. When the water heater finally fails, you have a plan — not a panic.
CARD_3_P: FincWin shows your housing spend as a percentage of your monthly income. Know immediately whether you're in the healthy 28–35% range or whether housing is crowding everything else out.
